description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveBalanceAPI, which is part of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, specifically testing leave balance-related API endpoints and behaviors within the leave module. It includes setup, multiple test cases with data providers for get, delete, update operations, and various scenarios for retrieving leave balances for employees based on different leave types, dates, and partial day options.

classes.name: LeaveBalanceAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies various functionalities of the LeaveBalanceAPI within the OrangeHRM system, including fetching leave balances, validation rules, and handling employee leave data with multiple scenarios and data providers.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test by populating fixtures for the LeaveBalanceAPI.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete method of LeaveBalanceAPI raises a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that the validation rules for delete operation are not implemented.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that the update method of LeaveBalanceAPI raises a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rules for update operation are not implemented.

methods.name: testGetLeaveApplicationService
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of LeaveApplicationService via internal method.

methods.name: testGetOneOnlyWithLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Tests the API's response for retrieving leave balance with specified leave type ID for different employees and scenarios.

methods.name: getOneOnlyWithLeaveTypeIdDataProvider
methods.description: Provides multiple data sets with different leave type IDs, employees, and expected responses for the above test.

methods.name: testGetOneSingleDay
methods.description: Verifies leave balance details for a single day across various leave types and partial day options.

methods.name: getOneSingleDayDataProvider
methods.description: Offers multiple scenarios for the single day leave balance retrieval including full day, half-day and holiday cases.

methods.name: testGetOneMultiDay
methods.description: Checks complex multi-day leave balances with partial days, holidays, and weekends.

methods.name: getOneMultiDayDataProvider
methods.description: Supplies data for testing multi-day leave balances with multiple partial day options and holiday considerations.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for fetching a single leave balance record, including validation of leave type, employee access, date parameters, and logical date order.
